recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a woman with a 1970s bouffant hairstyle, crouching in a field of dry, golden grass against a soft blue-to-tan gradient sky. She wears a white lace-detailed blouse and dark trousers, with a hand resting thoughtfully on her chin. The image features a heavy film grain and a warm, nostalgic color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the crisp white lace textures and the soft, blurred field background
Vertical alignment of the subject's face with the center-left third of the frame
Horizontal tension between the subject's dark clothing and the bright, airy sky gradient
coreInvariants: Warm, sepia-toned film grain across the entire image
Soft-focus background with a distinct blue-to-ochre vertical gradient
Crouching, triangular composition of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame in a crouching pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hand-to-chin gesture serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down the white blouse to the hands, then sweep across the textured grass to the typography in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper third, transitioning from a muted blue sky to the golden field.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Ochre and golden-brown (field and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high mid-tone warmth; shadows are deep but retain texture.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and faded blues

characterSpecificRedesigns: Thin, elegant strokes to match the delicate lace of the clothing

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in the sky negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme tracking to create a minimalist, modern contrast to the busy textures.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric 'O' and clean, thin lines match the era's high-end aesthetic.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1970s geometric sans-serif trend perfectly.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1970s film-style portrait of a woman with a dark bouffant hairstyle, wearing a white lace Victorian-style blouse and dark pants, crouching in a field of tall dry grass. The background is a soft gradient from light blue at the top to golden tan at the bottom. Apply heavy film grain and warm color grading.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in a light geometric sans-serif font in the top right corner. Set the tracking to be extremely wide so the letters span across the top right quadrant. Use white for the font color.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking wide enough to feel airy?
Does the film grain feel organic rather than digital noise?
Is the lace detail on the blouse sharp against the soft background?
Is the color palette restricted to warm earth tones and muted blue?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any specific artist signatures or logos

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in the clothing and grass

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is not touching the subject's head.
Ensure the sky gradient is smooth without banding.
Verify the crouching pose creates a stable triangular base.
Confirm the lace texture is visible and intricate.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered, textured subject in a pastoral setting with a two-tone vertical gradient background and minimalist, wide-tracked geometric typography in the upper negative space.
